notes: Not a game: a single-file RGB colour mixer (app title 'مدمج الألوان المتطور') with one screen plus one bottom sheet, so screens 1 and 2 are the same screen in two slider states (the three slider values are the only sample data; codes in screen 3 are computed from 103/58/183 exactly as the getters do). Arabic strings but the MaterialApp sets no locale/localization delegates, so the real layout is LTR - drawn LTR (e.g. 'اختر قيم RGB' shows RGB on the right, Red/Green/Blue left to right). Fidelity doubts: (1) the app-bar title is black on the purple gradient because the M3 default foreground (onSurface) is not overridden; (2) the sheet's Column has no mainAxisSize.min and isScrollControlled is true, so the sheet fills the whole screen with white space under the five tiles - drawn that way; status-bar icons drawn dark there for legibility; (3) the code font is 'monospace' (exists on Android; iOS would fall back to the system font) - drawn monospace; (4) UI font is the code's 'Arial'.
